propositions: The overview.txt and ticket-model.md documentation still claim unlink accepts no relation argument, contradicting the current optional relation-scoped unlink shipped in commit 73abb5805f.
The event-schema.md operation wording does not distinguish between the optional relation selector and the UUID-targeted UNLINK event cancellation.
Documented unlink contract must specify that explicit canonical relation removes exactly that relation while preserving other active relations on the pair.
When the relation argument is omitted, unlink must fall back to the most-recent relation on the pair.
The packaged CLI help output (rebar --help) and maintained prose surfaces must be synchronized to reflect the true optional-relation contract after relation-scoped unlink implementation.
